artworks.title: Pietro Moscati
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man named Pietro Moscati, showing a side profile from the shoulders up. He is facing right, with a prominent nose and a strong jawline. He has straight hair that reaches his neck and covers his ears, styled neatly. He is dressed in period attire with a high-collared jacket and a visible cravat around his neck. The background is dark, contrasting with his lighter features, and the portrait is framed by an oval border. The text outside the oval provides information about his role in the Executive Directory of the Cisalpine Republic and his affiliation with the Italian Society.

artworks.title: Festa Nazionale (National Holiday)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a classical scene with a detailed architectural setup. The horizon is high in the image, above the structure's roof adorned with statues. Beyond the architecture are trees and landscaped areas. The lines are fine and intricate, capturing the texture of the architecture and figures' costumes. Statues adorn tall columns, some spiraling upwards. The color palette is monochromatic. In the foreground, people in flowing garments are depicted, some on horseback. Beyond them are additional figures and the dominating architecture.

artworks.title: Nel Monastero dei Santi Quattro (In the Monastery of the Four Saints)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an interior space with a set of stairs on the left, a figure in a robe in the lower right, and an arched window in the background. Light filters through the window, illuminating part of the room and hinting at foliage outside. The image uses a monochrome palette, primarily in shades of gray. The lines are precise, defining architectural elements and the figure, while softer textures suggest natural elements outside. The view through the window shows a blurred suggestion of foliage without a clear horizon.

artworks.title: Nel Convento dei Cappuccini (In the Capuchin Convent)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an interior corridor with a staircase on the right-hand side. The hallway has a high, arched ceiling leading towards a bright opening in the background. Light fixtures and architectural details adorn the walls. The contrast between the dark interior and the illuminated outer space creates a dramatic perspective.

artworks.title: Ingresso di una Casa alle quattro Fontane (Entrance to a House at the Four Fountains)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural interior scene with two sets of stairs leading up to a series of arched doorways in the distance. There is an interplay of light and shadow within the enclosed space. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, creating crisp lines and defined forms, notably in the arches and stairs. The color palette is monochromatic with blacks and grays, and light seeps through the arches, illuminating parts of the scene. Figures are descending one of the staircases, adding scale and movement. In the distance, the arches are lit, drawing the eye down the corridor, while the background remains in shadow.

artworks.title: Nel Palazzo Giustiniani (In the Palazzo Giustiniani)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a staircase in an architectural setting. The image shows a wide stone staircase leading upwards, framed by an archway at the top. The stairway is steep and consists of numerous uniform steps. The light creates a contrast between the shadowed lower area and the illuminated upper landing, highlighting the open space at the top. The foreground contains elements associated with classical architecture.

artworks.title: Fortificazioni dei bassi tempi sopra il Ponte Nomentano (Fortifications of the Ponte Nomentano)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an interior view of a vaulted architectural structure, with an archway framing the scene. The interior features shadows, arches, and a figure leading livestock. The color palette is predominantly sepia. The pathway continues through another archway into the open space visible in the distance. The print is on textured, aged paper.

artworks.title: Nel Convento d’Aracoeli (In the Aracoeli Convent)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior architectural scene. The drawing depicts a dimly lit corridor or hallway within a historical building, featuring arched doorways and a set of stone steps. The monochromatic shading highlights the texture of the stone walls and the play of light and shadow within the space. A doorway emits a stream of light that casts elongated shadows along the floor, suggesting an opening to an exterior space. The overall composition captures the serene atmosphere of an old convent or historical place.

artworks.title: Rome, Arch of Titus
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a sculpture within an architectural structure featuring detailed carvings. The sculpture portrays a procession or gathering of figures in relief, positioned beneath ornate decorative elements, potentially on a pedestal or base. The sculpture is depicted in black and white on a textured surface. A person leaning against the structure provides scale and demonstrates the significant size of the relief.

artworks.title: Column in Saint Mark’s Square
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing next to a decorative column. The person is in a relaxed pose with folded arms, one leg crossed over the other. They wear a hat and a long robe. The column is ornately carved with faces and patterns. The background shows a broad view, possibly of water or a flat landscape. The setting appears peaceful and isolated.

artworks.title: Lombard Farmhouse (above); Saddled Donkey Standing in Front of a Shop (below)
artworks.medium: two etchings printed on one sheet of wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate (Lombardi Farmhouse): 11.6 × 8.8 cm (4 9/16 × 3 7/16 in.)
plate (Saddled Donkey): 8.8 × 11.8 cm (3 7/16 × 4 5/8 in.)
sheet: 45.1 × 27.7 cm (17 3/4 × 10 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features two small etchings placed one above the other on a larger sheet of paper. The top etching shows an arched passageway leading into a narrow cobblestone alley with a distant building. Surrounding architectural structures obscure the horizon. The intricate etched lines create texture, depth, and shadow. The lower etching shows a donkey tethered near a wooden structure with a "Cabinets" sign. Etched lines capture the donkey's fur, shadows, and cobbled ground. The color palette is predominantly gray, accentuating the technical detail and contrast of the etchings.

artworks.title: Two Peasant Women Before a Small Baptistry (above); Venice, Grand Canal (beow)
artworks.medium: two etchings printed on printed on one wove sheet
artworks.dimensions:
plate (Two Peasant Women): 12.2 × 9.2 cm (4 13/16 × 3 5/8 in.)
plate (Venice): 11.9 × 16 cm (4 11/16 × 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two detailed sketches in a monochromatic palette. The top sketch features a round, rustic building with intricate details and sparse trees. The lower sketch depicts a canal scene with a grand domed building in the distance and tall, narrow buildings on the left. Both sketches exhibit fine details and shading, emphasizing texture and form. The overall atmosphere is elegant and serene.

artworks.title: Woodland with a Stream Running Through
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a grove of trees surrounding a narrow body of water. The viewpoint is from the side near a group of large, leafless trees with branches creating patterns against the sky. The trees line both sides of the stream as it meanders into the background. The horizon is obscured by the dense arrangement of trees. The brushstrokes are detailed and precise, capturing textures and the ethereal quality of the branches. The color palette uses shades of gray to black, enhancing the moody and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Seated Man in Sixteenth-Century Costume
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man seated on a block with one leg propped up by the other knee. He has one arm resting on another block beside him, and his head is slightly downturned. The man's facial features are finely detailed, and he has short hair. He is wearing a loose, long-sleeved top and knee-length trousers. The background is softly shaded with minimal detail, and there are no visible accessories or objects. The artwork focuses on the man's form and posture.

artworks.title: Reclining Female Nude
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof]
artworks.description: The image shows a figure, likely female, seen from the back in a reclined position with her upper body visible. She leans forward with her arms resting on a surface covered in fabric. Her head is turned slightly to the side, and her facial features are not clearly shown. Her hair is dark and styled, possibly with a headband. The figure is nude, with a piece of fabric covering part of her lower body. She appears to be in a relaxed or resting posture. The background is dark and heavily shaded, emphasizing her form. There is a band or bracelet on her arm. The artwork is created in a sketchy style, resembling a sketch or etching with fine lines for texture.

artworks.title: Reclining Female Nude (recto); Architectural Design (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) etching on laid paper [proof] 
b) pen and black and brown inks over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a nude figure in a reclining position, with their body fully visible. They are propped up on their right arm, with their head turned to the side and resting on a pillow. The person's long, dark hair partially covers their face. The background features shaded areas resembling drapery or fabric, with subtle architectural details in one corner. The surface beneath the figure appears to be a piece of fabric or a blanket. The image is a black and white etching with strong contrasts and cross-hatching for texture.

artworks.title: South-West Point, Conanicut
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on fibrous brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. B. Riggs Parker, honoring their children
artworks.description: This painting shows a seascape with rugged cliffs rising on the right above the turbulent sea. Waves crash against rocks, sending white foam into the air. The jagged cliff face is in shades of gray and brown, with some pale green at the very top. The swirling sea below is in shades of blue and gray, and the sky above is cloudy, with one hint of blue at the top. On the left, white seagulls fly above the spray.

artworks.title: Burning Glass
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Rena Hoisington in honor of Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mechanical device with large wheels and an intricate structure. The device features a complex system of levers, handles, and reinforcing structural elements mounted on a platform with wheels. The apparatus is sketched with detailed hatching and cross-hatching techniques to give a sense of depth and form. There are stairs next to the device. The drawing highlights the craftsmanship and design of machinery from an earlier era with an emphasis on geometric precision and functionality.

artworks.title: "Slave Pen, Alexandria, Virginia"
artworks.artist: Brady's National Photographic Portrait Galleries, E. & H.T. Anthony
artworks.medium: stereoscopic albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a corridor with barred doors and rough, unfinished floors. The image shows a series of cells or holding areas along a narrow passageway constructed with brick walls and wooden beams. The rough floor appears to be made of dirt or irregular paving stones, and there are visible shadows suggesting the natural light entering the space. The photograph is bordered in orange, with text indicating it is related to the Civil War period, specifically mentioning "THE WAR FOR THE UNION" and referencing a "SLAVE PEN, ALEXANDRIA VA" at the bottom.

artworks.title: "Slave Pen, Alexandria, Virginia"
artworks.artist: Brady's National Photographic Portrait Galleries, Taylor & Huntington
artworks.medium: stereoscopic albumen silver prints
artworks.dimensions:
image/sheet (each): 7.9 × 7.7 cm (3 1/8 × 3 1/16 in.)
mount: 10.1 × 17.8 cm (4 × 7 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image is of a brick building with a sign that reads "PRICE, BIRCH & CO. DEALERS IN SLAVES." A tree and horse-drawn carriage are in front of the building. The scene shows a winter setting with sparse surroundings. The photograph is presented in a 19th-century stereographic format with an orange border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: daguerreotype
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, facing the camera with his body slightly turned to his left. His facial features include prominent eyes and slightly parted lips, with a hint of a mustache visible, and short hair under his hat. He is wearing a striped shirt beneath a light-colored jacket and a wide-brimmed hat. The background is plain and dark. The image is framed by an ornate, gold-colored border with red edges.

artworks.title: Theological Graduate School of Oberlin College, including John Mercer Langston
artworks.medium: daguerreotype
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a grid of nine portraits of different men, each captured from the waist up facing the camera. The men have varying facial features, hairstyles typical of the mid-19th century, and wear dark suits with white shirts and bow ties. The portraits are framed with an ornate gold finish, against a simple background, giving the image a historical vibe.

artworks.title: Oberlin College Graduates
artworks.medium: daguerreotype
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image is a collage of twelve individual portrait photographs. The portraits show the upper body or head and shoulders of the subjects, positioned in three rows of four portraits each. The individuals are directly facing the camera and have neutral expressions. They wear formal clothing typical of a past era, with the men in suit jackets and white shirts, and the women in dresses with visible collars. The subjects have neatly styled hair, ranging from combed-back styles for the men to parted and tied-up hair for the women. There are no visible jewelry or objects among the subjects. The background of each portrait is a neutral, dark shade. The collage is presented within an ornate, gilt-edged frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: daguerreotype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This grayscale photograph features a seated man, shown from the knees up. His body is slightly turned to the right, but he looks out at us, one arm resting on his lap and the other propped against a small round table on the right. The man has dark skin, faint eyebrows, high cheekbones, a faint mustache, lips set in a neutral expression, and short, dark hair under a tall white top hat with a thick gray band around the center. He is dressed in a formal black suit with a white, high-collared shirt, a black bow tie, and a dark jacket with a velvet collar. He appears to have a ring on one finger. The background behind him is light gray. The photograph is bordered by an ornate golden frame.
